author: stanford-star
description:
RelBench v1
	

The RelBench v1 databases and tasks, one database per subdirectory. The v2-only databases and tasks are in stanford-star/relbench-v2-extra. regression_stds.json holds the train-split target standard deviations that turn MAE into NMAE.
<dataset>/
  manifest.yaml                 # tables, primary keys, foreign-key graph, val/test timestamps
  schema.svg                    # ER diagram
  db/*.parquet                  # relational tables
  tasks/<task>/manifest.yaml    #… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/stanford-star/relbench-v1.
